name: elabora
description: Open core of Elabora: an open e-learning source format, a validator, a SCORM 1.2 compiler with executable LMS profiles, a free-object contract, skills and an MCP server for AI agents.

scripts.test:all: npm test && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:matrix
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/format && tsc -p packages/player && tsc -p packages/fonts && tsc -p packages/core && tsc -p packages/node && tsc -p packages/engine && tsc -p packages/cli && tsc -p .
scripts.gen: node scripts/gen-format.ts && node scripts/gen-builtin-templates.ts && node scripts/gen-agent-rules.ts && node scripts/gen-ai-costs.ts
